name: Visit Bandung
description: Official Bandung Tourism Office — city maps, event calendar, factory outlet guides, and recommendations for highland day trips including Tangkuban Perahu, Ciater, and the Lembang Plateau.

name: Saung Angklung Udjo
description: UNESCO-recognised bamboo music workshop and performance centre in Cicaheum. Daily afternoon shows, instrument workshops, and the angklung instrument shop. Ticket booking and group reservations.

name: Bandung Zoo
description: Bandung's century-old zoo on the edge of the Dago district — home to Sumatran tigers, Javan gibbons, and 200 other species. Opening hours and ticket prices for groups.

name: Trans Studio Bandung
description: One of Indonesia's largest indoor theme parks — 20 rides and attractions including a roller coaster and 4D cinema, all under one roof in the Trans Studio Mall complex. Booking and schedule enquiries.

name: Hotel Savoy Homann
description: 1939 Art Deco landmark directly opposite Gedung Merdeka. Concierge services, restaurant reservations at the heritage brasserie, and room bookings. The hotel where the 1955 Bandung Conference delegates dined.

name: Grand Hotel Preanger
description: C.P. Wolff Schoemaker's 1929 colonial modernist hotel on Braga. Sunday rijsttafel lunch reservations, rooftop event enquiries, and heritage tour partnerships for Braga walking itineraries.

name: Selasar Sunaryo Art Space
description: Bandung's leading contemporary art space — exhibitions by Indonesian and international artists across three gallery pavilions on a hillside above Dago. Workshop and residency programme enquiries.

name: Braga City Walk
description: Open-air shopping and dining complex on the heritage Braga strip — retail, F&B tenants, and weekend food markets. Event schedule and tenant directory.
